policy: Pose fits use only printed-stock profiles. Extra axes must improve model-selection strips. Final disjoint certification strips never optimize or select parameters; their fixed gates can only reject. Templates derive from 24 preselected calibration scans. Accepted transforms are comparison-only; renderer geometry never receives per-card poses.

syntheticValidation.objective: Mean correlation over all profiles, balanced by side. Median side confidence remains a quality gate. Extra model complexity requires at least 0.05px and 25% residual-RMS improvement plus correlation improvement on model-selection strips.

limitations: Upper type border can touch artwork: signed and absolute-gradient diagnostics are retained separately.
Clear CC plate shares opaque CC geometry; translucent color does not choose its own transform.
Frame color and all lettering remain unfitted.
Ghostfire and Aven Mindcensor have incomplete source-art crops.
Accepted scan poses are not a claim of subpixel accuracy for every region; residual uncertainty is recorded per card.
